definitions.short: a scorpion ; figuratively, a scourge or knotted whip
definitions.full: H6137. aqrab עַקְרָב noun masculine scorpion (apparently quadriliteral; Late Hebrew id. ; Assyrian a‡rabu ; Ethiopic ; Arabic ; עַקְרַבָּא ᵑ7 ); **< [ feminine ] as in Late Hebrew, Syriac, Mandaean, Arabic (Levy gives Talmud [Aramaic] as masculine , but are readings correct?), Nöldeke (privately). — absolute עַקְרָב Deut 8:15 (collective; of wilderness), plural עַקְרַבִּים Ezek 2:6 (figurative of enemies); בָּע ׳יִסַּר 1Kin 12:11 , 14 2Chr 10:11 , 14 , i.e. scourges with points, stings. — See also עַקְרַבִּים מַעֲלֵה .
